Team —

Finance asked for a final sweep of near-term opportunities ahead of the week-42 close. I pulled the SFDC list (see link below) and flagged a handful where the stage or close date looks optimistic vs our most recent engagement. We need owners to do one of the following by EOD Friday 10/16:

- Update the SFDC stage to reflect the latest status (e.g., move to Stalled / Evaluate if customer has not engaged in 14+ days).
- Update close date to realistic month or add a comment with the expected decision week.
- If you can provide explicit commit evidence (signed PO, DocuSign link, email confirmation with payment intent), paste the link into the Opp notes and reply here.

Specific asks:
- Evergreen Health (RDW-54321) — Marcus: we show close date 10/20 and stage = Negotiation. I don't see contract evidence in attachments. Please either attach meeting notes or set to Stalled if timeline slipped.
- ACME Pharm — Karthik: please confirm legal review status and whether ACME Legal submitted redlines.
- Meridian Clinics — Vanessa: last touch was 10/01; mark current expectation.

Why this matters: FP&A will freeze the forecast on Monday 10/19. If we can’t produce commit evidence for these deals they will be excluded from the committed column. Don’t leave deals hanging — if you need help getting evidence, escalate to your SE or I’ll join the next call.

Attachments: evergreen-meeting-notes-20261010.pdf (customer meeting notes), rdw-draft-sla-redline.docx (legal).

SFDC list: https://salesforce.com/0065g00000XyZqA
